DESCRIPTION: Unique numeric identifier assigned to each customer at account creation
Full legal name of the customer as registered in the system
Alphanumeric account number assigned by the financial institution
Current outstanding balance on the account in USD with 2 decimal places
The calendar date on which the transaction was posted in YYYY-MM-DD format
The monetary value of the transaction. Positive = credit
A three-letter code identifying the type of transaction (DEP/WDR/TRF/FEE)
Single character representing record status: A=Active
Three-digit numeric code identifying the originating branch location
Six-digit bank sort code used for inter-bank routing in format NN-NN-NN
The date from which this record version is valid in YYYYMMDD format
The date after which this record is no longer valid. NULL means no expiry
Two-character COBOL record type identifier (HD=Header TR=Trailer DT=Detail)
Sequential record number within the file starting from 1
Count of detail records between header and trailer
Sum of all TRANSACTION_AMOUNT values used for file-level reconciliation
